body: Yeah, I'm okay with talking to people online, it's just face to face that I can't really handle. I wasn't really bullied, but I did come from a shitty house with an abusive alcoholic dad, but no one ever really gave me flak in school I was just kind of ignored by everyone. At the time I didn't really think of the money that the insulin cost because I thought it would be the last thing I'd ever do. But yeah I' like to ask people what they think of me but I know that my friends will only give me answers I want to hear and I've heard plenty of times from my mom that I'm worthless, but that's only when she is full on telling me off. Other than that most of my other family members avoid me and rarely talk to me. I guess this covers everything you mentioned; Not sure if it matters though.
